method: Searched each upstream repo with gh search commits/prs/issues for: missing await, add missing await, forgot await, floating promise, no-floating-promises, unhandled rejection, unhandled promise, not awaited, forEach async, misused promise (see `searched`). Each candidate fix diff was read; only merged fixes of a behavioural bug caused by an un-awaited or unhandled promise were kept. flaggedBy is a judgment from the pre-fix code and the callee types at the parent commit, for typescript-eslint default options. Gathered by a Claude subagent; the lead agent then re-fetched each PR or commit and confirmed it is merged (commits: an ancestor of main) and that its patch contains the quoted change (`verifiedDiff`).

confirmed.title: fix: handle postcss load unhandled rejections
confirmed.description: A broken postcss.config.js made `vite build` emit two extra unhandled rejections on top of the real error, because a cache-warming call and a cache-update `.then` were left floating.
confirmed.fixedCode:
resolvePostcssConfig(config).catch(() => { /* will be handled later */ })
...
result.then((resolved) => {...}, () => { /* keep as rejected promise */ })
confirmed.flaggedReason: resolvePostcssConfig is `async` and called as a bare statement, and `result.then(onFulfilled)` with no rejection handler is also a floating Promise statement.

confirmed.title: fix(dev): handle errors in `watchChange` hook
confirmed.description: The chokidar 'add'/'unlink' listeners dropped the promise from async onFileAddUnlink, so a plugin's rejecting watchChange hook became an unhandled rejection that can kill the dev server (the new regression test reproduces it).
confirmed.flaggedReason: `onFileAddUnlink(file, false)` is a bare Promise statement in a block-bodied listener (no-floating-promises), and the `async` 'change' listener goes into EventEmitter.on's void-returning slot (no-misused-promises checksVoidReturn). Note: vite had both rules set to 'off' (see vite #22278).

confirmed.title: fix(assets): add the missing `await` to getHTMLAttributes
confirmed.description: If an image service's getHTMLAttributes returned a Promise, getImage() stored the Promise as `attributes`, so the custom HTML attributes never rendered (StackBlitz repro linked in the PR).
confirmed.flaggedReason: The promise is assigned into an object-literal property, not used as a statement, and a Promise is structurally assignable to Record<string, any>, so neither tsc nor either rule objects.

confirmed.title: fix(prefetch): swallow fetch-fallback rejection to avoid unhandled 'Load failed' on WebKit
confirmed.description: Safari always takes prefetch's fetch() fallback; on flaky connections the un-awaited, uncaught fetch rejected with `TypeError: Load failed` and reached sites' window.onunhandledrejection error monitoring.
confirmed.flaggedReason: `fetch()` returns Promise<Response> and is used as a bare statement. The PR says it 'slipped past no-floating-promises', but astro had the rule 'off' and only turned it on for tests in May 2026 (#16687); whether src/prefetch was covered by July is unverified.

confirmed.title: Stop aborted request bodies from logging duplicate unhandled rejections in @astrojs/node
confirmed.description: In @astrojs/node standalone mode, a client that disconnected mid-body made the async app handler reject with ECONNRESET. Nothing awaited that handler, so the error was logged as an unhandled rejection, often twice.
confirmed.buggyCode:
staticHandler(req, res, () => appHandler(req, res));
// serve-static.ts: (req, res, ssr: () => unknown) => { ... ssr(); }
confirmed.flaggedReason: The promise-returning handler goes through a parameter typed `() => unknown` and is invoked as `ssr();`. checksVoidReturn only fires on void-returning slots, and no-floating-promises sees an `unknown` call result, not a Promise.

confirmed.title: fix(test): ensure removeDir is properly awaited
confirmed.description: core-image tests flaked in CI because cache-directory cleanup (async removeDir) raced the following fixture.build(). Two failing CI runs are linked in the PR.
confirmed.flaggedReason: removeDir is `export async function removeDir(dir)`, called as a bare statement. Astro enabled no-floating-promises for tests one week later (#16687).

confirmed.title: fix(nodejs-middleware): await for body cloning to be properly finalized
confirmed.description: With Node.js middleware, the server action could run before the request body finished cloning, so large payloads failed with `SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input`.
confirmed.flaggedReason: finalize() is declared `Promise<void>`, but requestData.body is built from `getRequestMeta(...,'clonableBody') as any`, so the call's type is `any` and no-floating-promises stays silent. The `as any` hid the bug from the rule.

confirmed.title: Fix unhandled rejection in proxy-request
confirmed.description: Rewrites to an unreachable host logged `unhandledRejection: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND`, because the `.finally()` chain creates a new promise that re-rejects and nobody observed it.
confirmed.flaggedReason: A `.finally()` statement counts as handled only if its receiver is handled, and here the receiver is the bare Promise<boolean> `detached.promise`, so the statement is reported as floating.

confirmed.title: Prevent unhandled rejections when a "use cache" cache handler errors
confirmed.description: When a custom 'use cache' handler's get() threw, the deferred promise kept in the dedup maps had no consumer, so one error was logged up to four times, mostly through unhandledRejection handlers.
confirmed.flaggedReason: The promise is created and stored in a Map. It is never an expression statement, so no lint rule can see that nothing consumes it.

confirmed.title: Fix accessing headers in progressively enhanced form actions
confirmed.description: The PR states that progressively enhanced form actions 'did not work at all before in the Edge runtime due to a missing await of decodeFormState': formState held a Promise. The linked issue is about headers, and this missing await was a secondary fix in the same PR.
confirmed.fixedCode:
formState = await decodeFormState(
  actionReturnedState,
  formData,
  serverModuleMap
)
confirmed.flaggedReason: The promise is assigned to a variable rather than discarded, so no-floating-promises does not apply. Nothing flags a Promise stored in a loosely typed variable.

confirmed.title: Add missing await for API request
confirmed.description: In the cms-datocms example, getAllPostsWithSlug never awaited fetchAPI, so `data?.allPosts` was always undefined and SSG generated no paths.
confirmed.fixedCode: const data = await fetchAPI(`{ allPosts { slug } }`)
confirmed.flaggedReason: The file is plain JS (examples/cms-datocms/lib/api.js) and the promise is assigned to a const. In TS, tsc itself would reject `data?.allPosts` on a Promise.

confirmed.title: Fix missing awaits in comment thread widget
confirmed.description: Ctrl+Enter stopped submitting comments: the action runner fired updateCommentThreadTemplate (Promise<void>) and then ran the submit action without waiting for it.
confirmed.flaggedReason: ICommentService.updateCommentThreadTemplate returns Promise<void> and was a bare statement. IAction.run returns `unknown`, so that call would not be flagged. The fix itself passes an `async` function into a slot typed `(() => void) | null` and awaits a `void`-typed call, so no-misused-promises and await-thenable would flag the fixed code: the types still claim void.

confirmed.title: Fix issue with entering review mode on load by adding missing await
confirmed.description: In the git-extended (GitHub PR) extension, connectGitHub used forEach(async ...), so githubRepositories was assigned an empty array before any remote resolved, and review mode failed to enter on load.
confirmed.flaggedReason: This is the canonical checksVoidReturn case: an async arrow passed to Array.prototype.forEach, whose callback type returns void. forEach itself returns void, so no-floating-promises has nothing to flag.

confirmed.title: add missing await for git.clone and git.cloneRecursive command
confirmed.description: Because cloneRepository was not awaited, the `git.clone` / `git.cloneRecursive` commands resolved immediately, so callers of executeCommand('git.clone') could not wait for the clone or see its errors.

flaggedBy.other: require-await (the async method had no await)

confirmed.flaggedReason: cloneRepository is `async ... Promise<void>`, called as a bare statement. The enclosing async method also had no `await`, which require-await would report.

confirmed.title: Fix inoperative try/catch
confirmed.description: navigator.keyboard.getLayoutMap() rejects in nested browsing contexts. It was returned from inside try/catch without await, so the catch never ran and the error escaped as uncaught.

flaggedBy.other: return-await (in-try-catch) would apply, but only on a typed Promise

confirmed.flaggedReason: The promise is returned, not floating, so no-floating-promises is silent. return-await's in-try-catch check targets exactly this bug but needs a thenable type, and `navigator as any` makes it `any`, so in practice nothing fires.

confirmed.title: fix: handle failed terminal quick fix model request to avoid unhandled rejection (fixes #323149)
confirmed.description: When the Copilot terminal quick-fix model request failed, the `.then()` with no rejection handler produced an unhandled rejection in telemetry, and `r(picks)` never ran, so the quick pick stayed on 'Generating...' forever.
confirmed.flaggedReason: generateTerminalQuickFix is `async ... Promise<...>`, and `.then(onFulfilled)` with no onRejected is a bare statement inside the executor's block body. The neighbouring `picksPromise.then(...)` statement would be flagged too.

confirmed.title: fix: prevent unhandled rejection of language model result promise (fixes #322110)
confirmed.description: sendChatRequest returns {stream, result} and rejects both on error. Consumers' `for await` over the stream threw before they reached `await response.result`, leaving result's rejection unobserved: about 1.78M unhandled ChatQuotaExceeded hits across about 105K users.
confirmed.buggyCode:
const defer = new DeferredPromise<unknown>();
... return { result: defer.p, stream: ... }
confirmed.flaggedReason: The promise is returned inside an object and only skipped on an error path in consumer code. It is never a discarded expression statement.

confirmed.title: fix: prevent unhandled promise rejection from CopilotCLIQuotaExceededError (fixes #319622)
confirmed.description: A serialization chain (`previousRequest = previousRequest.then(() => handled)`) kept a rejected promise with no handler, so a quota error the caller had already handled was still reported as an unhandled rejection (944 hits / 555 users on one version).
confirmed.fixedCode: this.previousRequest = this.previousRequest.then(() => handled).catch(() => { /* prevent unhandled rejection on the serialisation chain */ });
confirmed.flaggedReason: The derived promise is assigned to a field, and no-floating-promises does not report assignment expressions, so the rejecting chain is invisible to it.

confirmed.title: Fix missing await in problemCollector
confirmed.description: tryBegin was made async that day (c5410560cf, 'Problem matcher file location auto detection'). The Promise in `if (this.tryBegin(line) || ...)` is always truthy, so WatchingProblemCollector.processLine returned early for every line. Caught and fixed the same day; no user report.
confirmed.flaggedReason: `private async tryBegin(line): Promise<boolean>` is used as the left operand of `||` in an if test, which is exactly what checksConditionals reports.

confirmed.title: fix(utils/stream): do not let abort listeners crash abort()
confirmed.description: StreamingApi.abort() called each `() => void | Promise<void>` subscriber inside forEach. On client disconnect, a rejecting async onAbort listener became an unhandled rejection that crashes Node; the new tests failed before the fix.
confirmed.fixedCode: per-listener try/catch; a returned thenable gets a no-op `.catch`
confirmed.flaggedReason: The forEach callback returns `void | Promise<void>`, which has a thenable union member, so checksVoidReturn reports it in forEach's void-returning slot. The promise is the arrow's return value, not a statement, so no-floating-promises is silent.

confirmed.title: fix(validator): `await` cached contents
confirmed.description: If an earlier middleware had already read the body, validator('json'|'form') received the cached Promise instead of the parsed body.
confirmed.flaggedReason: The type lied: BodyCache was declared `Partial<{ json: any; formData: FormData; ... }>` although it stored promises, and the value is assigned rather than discarded, so no type-aware rule could see it.

confirmed.title: fix(jsx): handle async component error explicitly and throw the error in the response
confirmed.description: With several async JSX components, a later component's promise could reject while an earlier one was still being awaited in a loop. No handler was attached yet, so it surfaced as `Uncaught (in promise)` and crashed the server.
confirmed.flaggedReason: The promises sit in an array and are awaited one at a time, so neither rule fires. Core ESLint's no-await-in-loop flags the `await buffer[i]`, and its suggested Promise.all is exactly the fix.

confirmed.title: fix: await generate hook
confirmed.description: toSSG() returned before an async afterGenerateHook finished, making a test fail intermittently (ref #2054); user hooks could still be running after toSSG resolved.
confirmed.flaggedReason: AfterGenerateHook is typed `(result) => void | Promise<void>`, and no-floating-promises treats a call whose type has a Promise union member (through the optional chain) as a floating promise.

confirmed.title: Fixed freezing async ZodReadonly results
confirmed.description: `.readonly()` schemas returned unfrozen objects from parseAsync(): _parse got back a Promise, `isValid(promise)` was false, and Object.freeze was skipped.
confirmed.flaggedReason: ParseReturnType is a sync|Promise union that is passed to a type guard and then returned. Nothing is discarded, and the guard accepts the union.

confirmed.title: fix WebSockets request parsing
confirmed.description: A WebSocket message with `id: null` made async handleRequest throw. The resulting promise array was discarded, so the rejection was unhandled and crashed the Node process: a remote DoS. Issue #1577 ('Add no-floating-promises... Would've prevented #1575') led trpc to enable the rule (#1671).
confirmed.flaggedReason: The statement's type is Promise<void>[] (handleRequest is `async`). Current typescript-eslint reports discarded arrays of promises (floatingPromiseArray). That check was added after this 2022 fix, so the v5-era rule trpc adopted would not have caught this exact line.

rejected.reason: Adds try/catch around an already-awaited runner.import in the full-reload handler (flaky test); not a floating/un-awaited promise fix.
Asset-URL resolution fix; unrelated to promises.
CSS ordering / cache fix; unrelated to promises.
Memory leak from storing promise.then(...) instead of promise in a Set (identity bug), not a floating promise.
Generated metadata-image loader read props.params synchronously after params became a Promise; the symptom was a dev sync-access warning, and the code is template-string generated.
Docs-only change (params typed as Promise in examples).
2017 Hapi example: request handler changed to return a promise. Feature/integration change, not a clean missing-await fix.
Real ordering bug (event fired before deletePassword resolved), but the author says it fixes no known issue; found by reading code.
canMove/canCopy/canDelete results not awaited, so `instanceof Error` validation was silently skipped. Real logic bug, but no reported symptom.
Missing await on viewsService.openView before setEditable; no documented symptom.
wsLink connectionParams race fixed by restructuring handshake; not a simple missing-await/floating fix in the diff.
Adds clientSubscriptions.delete in an existing .catch; resource cleanup, not an unhandled/floating promise.
The opposite fix: deliberately passes an un-awaited Promise<Blob> to the File System API to stay within the user-activation window.
Library import race fixed by queueing; introduces `new Promise(async ...)`; not a floating-promise fix.
Library load button fix via API change; unrelated.
Crash on rapid refresh in streaming JSX; fix wraps ReadableStream start() in try/catch plus onError, entangled with closed-controller enqueue; not a clean single floating-promise diff.
SSE writer hang on abort, fixed by cancelling the reader; not a floating promise.
Test-only change addressing an uncaught rejection warning, bundled with setErrorMap feature; no product bug.
z.function() `this` binding fix; unrelated to awaiting.

lintDrivenCleanups.note: 'fix: add missing awaits', with no reported symptom: server.close()/buildStart in tests, `stopProfiler` before process.exit(1) in cli.ts, scss compiler dispose. The cli.ts case could lose the profile on error exit, but nobody reported it.

Enabled some type-checked rules, but kept no-floating-promises, no-misused-promises and require-await 'off' because they 'require a lot of change'. await-thenable was kept off because it 'does not handle `void | Promise<void>` well'.

Turned on no-floating-promises (ignoreIIFE, allowForKnownSafeCalls for node:test) for tests only, one week after the #16624 removeDir flake. Before this it was 'off', and no-misused-promises stays 'off'.
Enabled no-floating-promises in packages (off for examples/tests). Closes issue #1577, which says the rule 'would've prevented #1575' (the WebSocket crash above).
Extended no-floating-promises to examples/**; fixes are `main()` -> `void main()` / `.catch(console.error)`.

Added a type-aware .eslintrc.cli.json with the stated goal of enabling no-floating-promises 'so that we don't need to rely on authors or reviewers catching unintentional missing awaits', but left it 'off' as a TODO. The follow-up WIP PR #67690 to enable it was closed unmerged on 2024-09-25.

notes: withastro/astro#17405 says the bug slipped past no-floating-promises "(enabled in #11089)". At the pinned SHA, astro/eslint.config.js turns the rule off for packages/**/src/**/*.ts "until we have the bandwidth to address all the errors", and prefetch/index.ts is under that glob.
trpc/trpc#1578 discarded an array of promises; current typescript-eslint reports that (calibration F11). Whether the 2022 version did was not checked.
